text: Illustrate the story here: The Jet Jim is in a jet. The jet is fast. His job is to jump from the jet. He sees a pond he can jump in. Jim jumps from the jet. He lands in the pond and gets wet. Jim swims in the pond and looks up at the jet.
paragraphs: Jim is in a jet. The jet is fast. His job is to jump from the jet. He sees a pond he can jump in.
